The app should make it clear while booking that the time cannot be extended and is fixed in stone, because my 8 cabinet kitchen cannot be deep cleaned in 180 minutes. The professional cleaned 2 of the easiest cabinets in the time she was here, and did not suggest that she would not be able to finish the whole thing on time.

I paid money for something I could have done myself. If the professional had been forthcoming about the timing, I could have at least told her to help with the harder to reach areas. You know, the reason for which this app exists. To HELP with household cleaning?
